description: CALL THIS when the user thinks a track deserves featuring: "this song should be featured", "nominate Shaka Zulu". Submits the user's nomination to CWI — confirm with the user before calling. Auto-scored against the editorial rubric (0-100), then human-reviewed. Returns nomination ID, the track's rubric score, and queue position. Rate limit: 3 per requester per 24h. Arguments: track_title, artist, nominated_by (required), reason (required).

reason.description: Why this track deserves the featured rotation (required).

track_title.description: Title of the track you are nominating.
